title: Introduce phased-invocation-latency-breakdown-and-adaptive-log-slicer
author: Maya Thompson
description: Context: SRE and product teams have asked for finer-grained timing breakdowns that surface where latency accumulates inside an invocation (request parsing, routing, model execution phases, post-processing, and streaming handoff). Existing per-request spans are coarse and confound root-cause during incidents. This PR adds: 1) a phased latency schema emitted by the runtime that splits an invocation into deterministic phases and per-phase micro-latencies; 2) an adaptive log-slicer that samples log payloads tied to high-phase-latency cohorts to keep cardinality bounded; 3) dashboard panels and an alert calibration helper that uses phase-level percentiles to mute noisy alerts and surface phase regressions; 4) a small SDK change to tag traces with phase fingerprints for downstream joins. Implementation notes: phased schema uses a compact enum for phases (parse, route, kv-warm, model-exec, stream, finalize) and attaches per-phase duration_ms and token_count where applicable; the log-slicer keeps a reservoir per-tenant-phase-cohort and uses a decay window to favor recent regressions; dashboard includes a Sankey-ish phase-flow panel, phase heatmap, and per-phase p50/p95/p99 histograms. Migration: old spans are still emitted; phased spans are additive and backward-compatible. Checklist: add phased schema and emission in runtime; add ingestion mapping and new telemetry tags; implement reservoir slicer and expose sampling metrics; add dashboard JSON and template variables; add unit tests and e2e integration test against a synthetic workload. Rollout plan: staged feature flag, enable for 10% of traffic in prod, monitor sampling overhead and cardinality, expand to 50% then 100% if metrics look good. Impact: expected increase in telemetry cardinality (controlled by slicer) and modest CPU overhead at max qps; no customer-visible API changes. Related: ENG-4821 tracks alert tuning follow-ups, SUP-987 recorded the customer incident that motivated this work.

ci_summary: CI passed: unit, integration, lint, mypy, and dashboard-json-schema checks all green. One flaky e2e run initially failed on the slicer timing; rerun fixed it after adding a test harness delay. No security findings.
release_notes: Add phased-invocation latency spans and adaptive log-slicer. New dashboards for phase flow and per-phase histograms. Feature gated and rolled out gradually; SRE to monitor sampling cardinality metric (observability.slicer.sampled_vs_dropped).
notes_for_oncall: If phase-level p95 increases without corresponding model-exec increase, suspect routing or kv-warm regressions. Use observability.slicer.sampled_vs_dropped to check slicer pressure. Toggle feature-flag redwood.obs.phased_latency to disable phased span emission if telemetry overhead becomes problematic.
